steps.name: board-core
steps.summary: desk/board.py(순수 함수: COLUMNS·LINK 상수·check_title/link/links·can_move·elapsed_days·candidate_mark·connection_state·progress)와 tests/test_desk_board.py 추가. 시각·today는 인자로 받음.

steps.name: board-files
steps.summary: paths.board_dir + desk/board.py 파일 함수(add/read/list/delete/archive/revive/request_start/cancel_request/add·update·delete_ref/read_refs/move_card/mark_pr/set_task), 예외 DuplicateTitle·WrongColumn·AlreadyRequested·NoRequest·TooManyLinks·NotFound, id=<epoch초>-<hex4>. list_cards 항목에 requested_at·request_broken·refs_broken 포함, (cards, 깨진 카드 수) 반환. 테스트 tests/test_desk_board_files.py

steps.name: board-view-response
steps.summary: desk/board.py에 BadQuery · build_view(cards_by_repo={레포:(cards,깨진수)}, phases_by_repo={레포:{task:index}|None}, today, now, query dict) · build_card_detail(card, refs, phase_index, today) 추가. 열별 cards·count·total, 카드 키(badge·pr_waiting·elapsed_days·progress·candidate·connection 등), 응답 최상위 columns·broken·archived. 테스트 tests/test_desk_board_view.py

steps.name: board-get-endpoints
steps.summary: page/server.py에 build_board(cfg,query)·build_board_card(cfg,repo,id) + GET /board(BadQuery→400, config·repos 추가)·GET /board/card(형식 오류 400, 없는 레포·카드 404) 추가. tests/test_desk_server_board_get.py 24개.

steps.name: board-post-endpoints
steps.summary: page/server.py에 POST /board/{add,delete,archive,revive,start,cancel,ref/add,ref/update,ref/delete} 추가(_handle_board_post, 기존 _check_post_guard 재사용, 오류는 {error: 짧은 코드}: 400 검증·모르는 레포(add) / 404 없는 카드·링크·모르는 레포(id 동작) / 409 duplicate·conflict). tests/test_desk_server_board_post.py 36개, 전체 837개 통과.
